rows.question: What is the average 'weight' of the "INTERACTS" relationships of characters with 'community' value of 579?

WHERE c.community = 579
MATCH (c)-[r:INTERACTS]->()
WITH avg(r.weight) AS average_weight
RETURN average_weight

rows.pred_cypher: MATCH (c:Character {community: 579})-[r:INTERACTS]->() RETURN avg(r.weight)
rows.label: correct

rows.question: Name the top 3 characters based on the sum of their book1PageRank and book45PageRank.

WITH c, (c.book1PageRank + c.book45PageRank) AS totalPageRank
RETURN c.name AS characterName, totalPageRank
ORDER BY totalPageRank DESC
LIMIT 3

ORDER BY totalRank DESC

rows.question: Find the characters with the top 3 highest 'book45PageRank' values who interacted with "Cersei-Lannister" in book 45.

MATCH (c:Character {name: "Cersei-Lannister"})-[:INTERACTS45 {book: 45}]->(other:Character)

LIMIT 3
RETURN other.name AS character_name

MATCH (cersei:Character {name: "Cersei-Lannister"})
MATCH (other:Character)
WHERE other.degree > 10 AND (     (cersei)-[:INTERACTS]->(other) OR      (cersei)-[:INTERACTS1]->(other) OR      (cersei)-[:INTERACTS2]->(other) OR      (cersei)-[:INTERACTS3]->(other) OR      (cersei)-[:INTERACTS45]->(other) )
RETURN DISTINCT other.name
rows.raw:
MATCH (cersei:Character {name: 'Cersei-Lannister'})-[:INTERACTS]-(other:Character)
WHERE other.degree > 10
RETURN other.name AS character, other.degree AS degree
